findings: S5 WARN: 04-uiux-brief.md carries the companion's palette as family, tone and shade words rather than as literal values. That is the A5 decision recorded in generate_instruction.md and enforced by source_lint colour_words; a spec doc holding hexes would put them one copy away from the brief, where G51 forbids them. Type is carried exactly, as A5 requires.

S8 WARN: 00-decisions.md carries more than residual judgment calls: it also carries the companion carry table, which the supplied-source rules require to be written as the author goes. Recorded rather than trimmed, because the table is the human-readable twin of the G51 receipt.

A1 WARN: eleven H2 sections are present, with `## Front-end specification` occupying the slot A1 names `## Build plan`. generate_instruction 2.1 excludes Build plan at baseline and reference/A registers `frontend` as a legal spec_sections_given token, which task.toml declares. No section is missing.

C5 WARN: C5 asks for concurrency invariants in `## Data model` as named storage-engine constructs. INV9 and G43 forbid that vocabulary in that section, so each invariant is stated observably instead, for example that two simultaneous funded enrolments never both succeed and treasury_remaining never falls below zero. G43 passes and the property is what the pytest layer asserts.

C7 WARN: `## Core features` runs to about 16,600 characters against the 2,500-character point where run_rubric slices a section, and the joined six sections run past 9,000. The tail reaches the agent in full and stops reaching the judge. Accepted deliberately: the brief carries a companion PRD's obligations and G33 reports length rather than failing it, and judge_score never touches reward. The critical focus, the role boundary and the entitlement rules are front-loaded inside the first slice.

RC-15 WARN: the loop converged on cycle 2, not cycle 1. Cycle 1 found three criteria failing the mechanical text battery (a bare `no`, the connector `while`, and the pronoun `it`); each was re-authored in grounding.yaml judged_criteria and the rubric regenerated. Cycle 2 is clean on every check.

DEP-011 NOT-APPLICABLE: `[verifier].environment_mode` is `separate`, so the grader ships its own image from `tests/Dockerfile` on `deku-verifier-base` and the agent image owes it no Python package. G55 RD-1 skips for the same reason.
DEP-012 NOT-APPLICABLE: playwright is not installed in the agent image, so Chromium's system libraries are not owed here.
DEP-013 NOT-APPLICABLE: no `playwright install` step exists in the agent image.
DEP-015 NOT-APPLICABLE: `[metadata].language` is `javascript`, so the multi-stage compiled-language profile does not apply.
DEP-016 NOT-APPLICABLE: there is no compiled-language build stage; npm resolves inside the build at app-build time.
DEP-017 NOT-APPLICABLE: `language` is not `java`, so no JRE is owed.
ARCH-002 NOT-APPLICABLE: the base is pinned by the explicit tag `node:20-bookworm-slim`, which is a multi-architecture manifest list, rather than by a digest. reference/C C.4 prefers the tag.
ARCH-003 NOT-APPLICABLE: no image digest appears in the bundle, so none can be fabricated. `[delivery.images]` is omitted for the same reason.
BP-004 NOT-APPLICABLE: the image performs no build-time download for which a source supplies a checksum.
BP-005 NOT-APPLICABLE: the runtime is Node with no build-only toolchain to discard, so a multi-stage build would add a stage and remove nothing.

CMP-020 NOT-APPLICABLE: superseded by CMP-022. `main` must set `extra_hosts` and `ports`, so it cannot exist solely to express `depends_on`; the two rows cannot both be satisfied and CMP-022 is the later rule, with the lost-trial evidence behind it.

SEC-003 WARN: the agent image runs as root. The base ships a `node` user, but every reference environment in the kit runs as root and the App Contract requires the app to write `/app/USER_README.md` and the two reserved directories at `/app`. Recorded rather than changed, because a non-root switch that no source establishes is the kind of unforced change the hallucination policy exists to stop.
TAX-006 NOT-APPLICABLE: `language` is `javascript`, not `any`, and the task is not a smoke task.

TAX-008 SKIP: global archetype uniqueness cannot be decided from the supplied inputs. It is enforced by the mint ledger, which claimed `proctored-credential-academy` atomically at S1 and appended the row to Output/ledger.jsonl.
BENCH-002 NOT-APPLICABLE: the Trivial resource tier applies to a smoke task; this bundle is on the Standard tier and BENCH-001 holds.
BENCH-005 NOT-APPLICABLE: `difficulty` is the empty placeholder the Calibration Engineer fills, so there is no declared difficulty to be consistent with.
INT-007 NOT-APPLICABLE: the same empty `difficulty` placeholder means the difficulty, tier and budget triple cannot be cross-checked here.
SIGN-001 NOT-APPLICABLE: the `[signoff]` table is retired; SIGN-004 carries the live rule and passes.

SIGN-003 NOT-APPLICABLE: retired with the `[signoff]` table.

SEC-002 WARN: `AUTH_ADMIN_TOKEN` is verifier-only and absent from the agent environment, which is what SEC-001 requires. Recorded here because the auth slot has no capability adapter in the vendored grader, so that token grades nothing today and exists to keep the INV4 split honest rather than to be read.
